title: Customers with both a checking and a savings account
prompt: How many customers hold both a checking account and a savings account?
population: Customers, checked against their set of account_types.
metricDefinition: count of customers holding both a checking and a savings account.
transformationPlan: find customers with a checking account
find customers with a savings account
count customers present in both sets
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM accounts WHERE account_type = 'checking') c JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM accounts WHERE account_type = 'savings') s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id

commonWrongAnswers.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM accounts WHERE account_type IN ('checking', 'savings')
commonWrongAnswers.whyWrong: Counts customers with EITHER a checking OR a savings account, not customers who hold both — the IN clause doesn't require both types to be present.
